WQ1.headline: About 9 in 10: China keeps its capital controls through 2035 and opens only by quotas and pilots. Full convertibility is 3 in 100 by 2030 and 8 by 2035, and if it came, money would flow out first and help the dollar.
up: SAFE keeps the $50,000 individual quota and issues QDII only when the yuan is strong
Reserves or the yuan come under pressure, as in 2015 to 2016, and outflow rules tighten
US-China sanctions risk rises, which makes Beijing value control over openness
down: SAFE lifts the individual quota to $200,000 or more, or turns it into a registration
QDII and Southbound Connect quotas are abolished rather than topped up
The PBoC widens the 2% daily band or stops guiding the fixing for months
WQ1.watch: SAFE quota releases and monthly reserves (7th of each month), then COFER Q3 2026 in late December 2026 (CNY 2.11% now, tell above 3%)

WQ2.headline: A bit better than even: the likeliest path is slow erosion, inflation wiping about a fifth of the debt's real value by 2035 with captive buyers holding it. A one-time revaluation clearing 50% to 80% is about 1 in 100.
up: The 10-year breakeven rises above 2.75% while real yields fall
The Fed buys long bonds or uses yield language in a market-functioning episode
Stablecoins pass 10% of T-bills after the GENIUS reserve rules switch on 2027-01-18
down: The Warsh Fed keeps hiking and inflation returns to about 2%
Primary deficits shrink sharply, so the debt is paid rather than eroded
Treasury changes the $42.2222 gold book value or Congress touches 31 U.S.C. 5117, the first sign of a one-time route
WQ2.watch: 10-year breakeven against 2.75% (2.37% now), then FOMC on 2026-12-09 and the Cook removal hearing on 2026-11-05
